'''Ming Huo''' (PC handle '''mingtown''') played the [[2025 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-09-world-championship-seattle-washington-october-4-5-2025/ 2025 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="mingtown-2016">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/mingtown-local-tournament-weekend-11132016-eau-claire-wi/ Ming – Local Tournament Weekend – 11/13/2016 – Eau Claire, WI], starwarsccg.org (17 November 2016). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/swccg-pc-mingtown-eau-claire-2016/mingtown-local-tournament-weekend-11132016-eau-claire-wi.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

He described Decipher-era [[Squadron Members]] as volunteers who helped Decipher coordinate events, and said '''FL''' on the published Squadron Member tables stands for Flight Leader.<ref name="slack-ming-2026">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Ming Huo (mingtown), 9 October 2026. "basically a volunteer that helped decipher coordinate events."</ref>
